# R4.15d — Remote `fetch` transports with the adopted trust fields (DF-S4.2-1, OQ-332)

Spec: `docs/tickets/164k_R4.15d__remote-fetch-trust-fields.md` · base `svitali/harnessharness-r4.15c` @ bffe21b · `live_verification=true` · requirement ids: `DF-S4.2-1` · `BL-32` (remote half) · OQ-332 · R-2.9.3, R-2.10.3, R-2.10.5-adjacent · ADR-0293 trigger · ADR-0365 (TLS home) · ADR-0375 (new — mediation shape).

## Summary

Lands the remote half of `manifest.locations[]` fetch — the last open leg
of BL-32 — under the `FetchTrustPolicy` MUST-data GATE-G7 **"Adopt all"**
adopted from the bl33 §trust-fields text (`docs/build/LEDGER.md` GATE
DECISIONS, 2026-10-22). `transport_pending` is gone; every remote leg now
answers a typed arm.

- **`FetchTrustPolicy` (`hh-bundle-fetch-trust/1`, `hh/` namespace).**
  `hh-bundle/src/trust.rs` owns the record —
  `{admission_classes[], admitted_origins[], accepted_signers: SignerRef[],
  require_ledgered_arrival}` — parse/validate, canonical JSON, `idp/1`-style
  `version_id()` pin coordinate for `resolved_dependencies`. The admission
  class sum is closed: `first_party` | `signed_url` | `content_addressed`.
- **Admission.** `admit()` classifies each location — cleartext `http:` and
  credentialed locators refuse pre-classification (`transport_refused`);
  `first_party` checks `https:` against the declared origin allowlist
  (host / host:port forms, fail-closed parse); `signed_url` admits
  presigned carriers (sig-params / `X-Amz-Signature` / Azure `sig` /
  `mh_secret:` placeholder carriers — literal credentials never persist);
  `content_addressed` admits `ipfs:`/CID spellings and then refuses the
  fetch `transport_unsupported` — the adopted class with an honestly
  absent transport (ADR-0375). `expires` is enforced at the entry and
  inside the carrier (`Expires`/`se`/`X-Amz-Date`+`X-Amz-Expires` →
  `location_expired`); undeclared classes → `class_not_admitted`; absent
  policy + remote locations → `policy_absent`.
- **The wire is Π-mediated.** `kernel.fetch{path | container,
  addresses[], trust?, tls_extra_roots_file?}` opens a kernel-owned
  `purpose="fetch"` run carrying the kernel scope chain
  (`kernel-fetch-turn`/`kernel-fetch-mc`/`kernel-fetch-tc`/derived
  `Store::effect_id`), lowers the declared policy to a `mediated`-mode
  `ContainmentPolicy` (allow rules per `admitted_origins[]`,
  `default_unmatched = deny`, `non_public_destinations =
  allow_listed`), and drives every admitted `https:` GET through the
  real `EgressMediator` — `security.egress.requested/decided` durable on
  the fetch run before wire activity, `LocalTlsTransport` +
  `SystemResolver` + `hh_tls` webpki-roots verification + the one
  `hh_wire::http` codec (the ADR-0365 home; `tls_extra_roots_file` for
  fixture CAs — never an insecure skip).
- **Durable arrival + S3 re-verify.** Every attempt appends
  `bundle.member.fetched{address, location_uri, fetched_at, transport,
  outcome}` on the fetch run before verified bytes deposit
  (`require_ledgered_arrival` fails closed); the fold recomputes
  `idp_id("blob", bytes)` per materialization — a location's digest
  claim is never trusted, `digest_mismatch` deposits nothing; locations
  are tried in order with honest fallback. Class row registered in
  `hh-ledger`'s class table; `EventFamily::Bundle` → run_lifecycle
  plane registered in `hh-ontology` + `hh-ledger`'s event table.
- **Credentials outside URIs.** Literal userinfo/embedded secrets
  refuse before classification; `mh_secret:` placeholder carriers
  classify `signed_url` and are substituted by the broker at the wire
  (egress path/body sentinel drain) — no credential text ever lands in
  a ledger row (ADR-0375's carrier ruling; `validate.rs::credentialed`
  gained the documented placeholder exception).
